audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored as Lucian's in both layers' side/win fields while the prose (whys[4]) correctly called it Galio's window.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance (180/160/140s) lands Galio on an ally from 4000/4750/5500 units with a knockup and a magic shield; The Culling does not answer that. The page rendered two opposite answers for the same row.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Galio in phases[4].side and win[4] as a matched pair, rating inverted, and phases[4].why rewritten to match whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named the W taunt as the level 2-3 spike without the knockup or any cooldown.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and is the engage; Shield of Durand is 18/17/16/15/14s. The pairing is the spike, not W alone.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and whys[4] now carry the real cooldowns and the actual engage sequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer stated that Galio's own crowd control arms Lightslinger.
audit.why: Lucian's passive: when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Justice Punch, Shield of Durand and Hero's Entrance all immobilize, so Galio engaging hands Lucian two empowered autos. This matches the mirror audit's finding from Galio's side.
Colossal Smash is an auto-attack reset with an area component — the wind-up, not a cast, is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Not written: no writable path had room inside the length band without displacing a higher-value fact. Recorded here.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is 180s but global — he drops on an ally, knocks you up, and the taunt lands before your E.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance plus his R-into-W burst makes 6 his window — even shoved in he threatens to ult an ally onto you or all-in you if you overstay.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance (180s at rank 1) makes 6 his window — he lands on an ally 4000 units off, knocks you up, and the taunt follows before you can E out.

edits.before: His W taunt comes online — when he can Justice Punch in and Shield of Durand taunt you, your whole kite plan inverts and he owns the trade.
edits.after: Justice Punch (11s) plus Shield of Durand comes online — the knockup then the taunt, and every second locked is free damage on a 500-range Q.

edits.before: Track Galio’s Justice Punch: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Justice Punch (11s at rank 1): no engage while it is down. His knockup and taunt arm Lightslinger — two bonus-magic autos.

edits.before: Galio spends Justice Punch early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Justice Punch is down 11s at rank 1 — bait it, E out of the taunt, then cash your two armed autos.

notes: Level-6 row disagreed with its own prose in both layers; flipped as a matched pair. Mirror (galio__lucian) already established the Lightslinger-immobilize interaction — restated from Lucian's side, no contradiction introduced.
